title: koeleria cristata subsp. gracilis
intro: Koeleria cristata subsp. gracilis, commonly known as small blue grass, is a plant species belonging to the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from respiratory issues, such as bronchitis, and aiding in the treatment of digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of Koeleria cristata subsp. gracilis are attributed to its ability to act as an expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant agent. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
